passive.name: Rebirth
passive.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.

primaryAbilities.name: Flash Frost
primaryAbilities.description: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Anivia fires a massive chunk of ice, dealing {{ totalpassthroughdamage }} magic damage and Chilling enemies for {{ slowduration }} seconds, Slowing them by {{ spell.glacialstorm:slowamount }}%. At the end of its range, the ice detonates, Stunning enemies for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totalexplosiondamage }} magic damage.

Anivia can Recast this ability while the ice flies to detonate it early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Crystallize
primaryAbilities.description: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Anivia summons a wall of ice {{ wallwidth }} units wide. The wall lasts for {{ wallduration }} seconds before it melts.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Frostbite
primaryAbilities.description: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing damage. If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Anivia blasts an enemy with a freezing wind, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Against <keywordMajor>Chilled</keywordMajor> enemies, Anivia deals <magicDamage>{{ empowereddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Glacial Storm
primaryAbilities.description: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Toggle: Anivia calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail that Slows enemies by {{ slowamount }}% and deals {{ totaldamagepersecond }} magic damage per second. The storm increases in size over {{ growthtime }} seconds.

When the storm is fully formed, it Chills, Slows by {{ slowpercentempoweredtt }}%, and does {{ empowereddamagepersecondtooltiponly }} magic damage per second instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

allSpellRecords.name: Glacial Storm
allSpellRecords.summary: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Toggle: Anivia calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail that Slows enemies by [20 / 30 / 40]% and deals [30 / 45 / 60 + (0.125) × AP] magic damage per second. The storm increases in size over [1.5] seconds.

When the storm is fully formed, it Chills, Slows by [30 / 45 / 60]%, and does [(30 / 45 / 60 + (0.125) × AP) × (3)] magic damage per second instead.

allSpellRecords.name: Rebirth
allSpellRecords.summary: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg, healing to full Health and receiving [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=-40, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 5, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 15.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 8, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 15.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 15.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 15.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] Armor and Magic Resist. If she survives for 6 seconds, she is reborn.
